newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela 750 mln mark bond issue to start next wk.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela 750 mln mark bond issue to start next wk.

text.p: Venezuela hopes to start a 750 million mark ($508 million) bond issue in Europe next week, Finance Ministry Public Finances Director Nestor Suarez said Monday.
"We hope that by starting the issue next week it will last about three weeks although we think it could be shorter," Suarez told Reuters.
The issue, which is to be pay debt arrears from 1994 and 1995, will be led by Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale .
The bonds will have a maturity of seven years and a coupon of 10.375 percent, Suarez said.
"This issue represents the start of the reinsertion of Venezuela in the European financial markets after an absence of more than eight months," he said.
